descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S18 Nothing changes unless the physician confirms: an empty read, 'Decide later', or closing the sheet

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture resident In Today; QA Fir (In Today), QA Gum and QA Hazel (not In Today) seeded as in S06

When (a) Scan a page with only a header row → close the sheet. (b) Scan supervisor-mixed.jpg → tap 'Add N to Today's Visits' → on 'Possible duplicate residents' press 'Decide later' → close the scan sheet → Today's Visits. …

Then (a) The app says clearly that no residents were found and adds nothing (Empty & Failure States: 'Explicit message; nothing added'). (b) and (c) Nothing is written: QA Juniper, QA Kestrel and QA Hosp Ivy are not created, QA Gum stays off today, and QA Fir and the fixture resident stay on today

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s18-today-b and s18-today-c contain {snfResident} and QA Fir and none of QA Gum, QA Juniper, QA Kestrel or 'In Today ✓' (a write before the decision would un-mark the fixture resident on main and mark Gum); s18-all contains {snfResident}, QA Fir, QA Gum, QA Hazel and 'In Today ✓' and none of QA Juniper, QA Kestrel, QA Hosp Ivy (U3 'before anything is written'). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.
